metrics.name: firebird_transactions_total
metrics.help: Next Transaction ID (steigt mit jeder neuen Transaktion)

metrics.sql: SELECT MON$OLDEST_TRANSACTION, MON$OLDEST_ACTIVE, MON$OLDEST_SNAPSHOT, MON$NEXT_TRANSACTION - MON$OLDEST_TRANSACTION, MON$NEXT_TRANSACTION - MON$OLDEST_ACTIVE FROM MON$DATABASE

columns.name: firebird_transaction_oat_gap
columns.help: Next minus OAT (Alter der aeltesten aktiven Transaktion in Transaktionen)

metrics.sql: SELECT COUNT(*), COALESCE(MAX(DATEDIFF(SECOND, MON$TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)), 0) FROM MON$TRANSACTIONS WHERE MON$STATE = 1 AND MON$TRANSACTION_ID <> CURRENT_TRANSACTION

columns.name: firebird_transaction_oldest_active_seconds
columns.help: Alter der aeltesten aktiven Transaktion in Sekunden

metrics.sql: SELECT COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN MON$STATE = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM MON$ATTACHMENTS WHERE MON$ATTACHMENT_ID <> CURRENT_CONNECTION

metrics.name: firebird_attachments_by_user
metrics.sql: SELECT MON$USER, COUNT(*) FROM MON$ATTACHMENTS WHERE MON$ATTACHMENT_ID <> CURRENT_CONNECTION GROUP BY MON$USER
SELECT COUNT(*), COALESCE(MAX(DATEDIFF(SECOND, MON$TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)), 0) FROM MON$STATEMENTS WHERE MON$STATE = 1 AND MON$ATTACHMENT_ID <> CURRENT_CONNECTION

columns.name: firebird_statement_longest_seconds
columns.help: Laufzeit des laengsten laufenden Statements in Sekunden

metrics.sql: SELECT MON$PAGES * MON$PAGE_SIZE, MON$PAGE_BUFFERS, MON$SWEEP_INTERVAL FROM MON$DATABASE
SELECT io.MON$PAGE_READS, io.MON$PAGE_WRITES, io.MON$PAGE_FETCHES, io.MON$PAGE_MARKS FROM MON$IO_STATS io JOIN MON$DATABASE d ON d.MON$STAT_ID = io.MON$STAT_ID

SELECT r.MON$RECORD_SEQ_READS, r.MON$RECORD_IDX_READS, r.MON$RECORD_INSERTS, r.MON$RECORD_UPDATES, r.MON$RECORD_DELETES, r.MON$RECORD_BACKOUTS, r.MON$RECORD_PURGES, r.MON$RECORD_EXPUNGES FROM MON$RECORD_STATS r JOIN MON$DATABASE d ON d.MON$STAT_ID = r.MON$STAT_ID
SELECT m.MON$MEMORY_USED, m.MON$MEMORY_ALLOCATED FROM MON$MEMORY_USAGE m JOIN MON$DATABASE d ON d.MON$STAT_ID = m.MON$STAT_ID

metrics.name: firebird_custom_table_count
metrics.help: Beispiel: Anzahl Zeilen in einer Anwendungstabelle (Tabellenname anpassen, dann enabled auf true)

metrics.name: firebird_business_metric
metrics.help: Beispiel: Business-Metrik mit Label aus einer Tabelle
